verseText: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
meaning: God has done many wonderful things in the past to rescue his people. It is good for us to look back and remember them.

recall.question: What are God's “wonders of old?”
choices: God's mighty miracles from the past

meaning.question: Why should we remember what God has done in the past?
choices: It helps us trust Him now
It's fun to read about his wondrs of old
It means we'll be able to do wonders, too

application.prompt: Think of a Bible story where God rescued His people, like when He made a path through the sea. How could remembering these stories help you trust God with something difficult today?
